description: Election Commission - Mr. A. L. Rafeek of the Kalmunai Municipal Council has vacated his office of that M/C - Mr. Y. M. Mushammil of the Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of that P/S
categorisation: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices in local government bodies (Kalmunai Municipal Council and Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local authorities, making it clearly fall under Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
